name: uberasm-event-camera-pan
title: Event Camera Pan
description:
This UberASM allows you to make the camera scroll to a specified location when running an event (either at the start or before a certain step in the middle of the event), and then return back to its original position afterwards. You can also add a delay before scrolling to make it less abrupt. You can set a different position for every event, and of course set events to not scroll at all (also the effect only applies to the Main Overworld map for obvious reasons, so insert it as Overworld code 00).
Check out the asm file for more info.
